specDepartures.spec: Fix: size the padding so it never reaches the line above at any size Dispatch renders.
specDepartures.plan: calc((1lh - 1.2em) / 2) never reaches the line above at any size or pitch for fonts whose content area is at most about 1.27em at the tightest pitch (every font a phone or the tests resolve); a larger one such as Segoe UI (system-ui on Windows, in a window under 1280px) still reaches about 0.8px into the line's internal leading at 12px on 16px, down from about 3px.
specDepartures.evidence: Clearance = (1lh - (2r - 1.2) em) / 2 with r the font's content area per em; measured in pod Chromium with DejaVu Sans (r 1.164): reasoning clearance -1 -> 1.20. Segoe UI's r 1.33 is a published metric, not measured.
